title: DriftEvent
description: The one shape pikopod emits for a detected provider drift — to stdout, to the Slack webhook sink, and to the local event log (<data_dir>/events.ndjson). schema_version gates compatibility; consumers MUST ignore unknown fields.

fingerprint.description: Stable id of the divergence; same diff → same fingerprint across occurrences.

endpoint.description: Path TEMPLATE (e.g. /transaction/tx_{id}) — never a concrete path; concrete identifiers must not egress.

status_class.description: Always emitted; empty string on DECLARED events (a spec change has no wire status).

kind.description: Observed kinds are the closed enum below; DECLARED events (source=declared) carry declared:<spec-diff check id>.

field.description: Field path within the body (slash-joined), when kind concerns a field.

before.description: Reference-side view: dominant type, known value set, or prior status class.

after.description: Observed-side view: new type, new value, or new status class.

source.description: Absent = observed drift (traffic vs baselines); "declared" = the provider changed their SPEC (spec-diff engine).

level.description: Derived severity: declared per the spec-diff law, observed per the risk asymmetry (removed/type=ERR, new enum value=WARN, additive/documented=INFO). Absent on events persisted before it existed.

detail.description: Pre-rendered human sentence for declared findings.

note.description: Declared×observed join context (e.g. the provider's new spec version documents this change).
